title: Second Brain: Crafted, Curated, Connected, Compounded
excerpt: A crafted digital vault of curated knowledge where insights and ideas connect and compound, modeled after a Zettelkasten to inspire learning and discovery.
content_html:
Crafted, Curated, Connected, Compounded

Welcome to my public Second Brain, a crafted knowledge vault where my notes, ideas, and insights are carefully curated, connected, and compounded over time. This vault is modeled as a digital Zettelkasten and Garden.

Navigation

🔍

Search

Use the search bar on the top right or press cmd+k (ctrl+k on Windows) to find any term, or open the full search page.

🔗

Follow Links

Click on a note and follow the links and backlinks to dive deeper, or use Graph Explorer for semantic search and hidden connections.

🧠

Graph View

Interact with the graph at the bottom of the page to visualize connections between notes and navigate directly.

Map of Content

My Second Brain is continuously growing, and while I have some essential Map of Content (MOC) starting points listed below, there are many more topics to discover as you explore. Feel free to dive into any of the following areas:

Deep Life

Digital Minimalism, Deep Work, What Makes a Happy Life, Thoughts on Journaling, Stoic, Routines, Reading Books for a Happy Life, Minimalism, Pathless Path, Dumb Phone, What I Have Learned Abroad

Neovim

Vim, Neovim Setup,Vim Motions, Query Databases in Vim, Vim Language, Vim for Obsidian, Why Vim is More Than Just an Editor, Vim Anywhere, Unix Philosophy, Dotfiles, TUIs

Enjoy exploring my Second Brain. I hope you find valuable insights and connections that inspire or help you on your journey.

About This Second Brain

For the quality of these notes and what to expect, check out the Disclaimer. Otherwise, learn more about the principles behind this knowledge vault and how it's organized to provide lasting value.

Crafted

Intentionally shaped notes to educate and inspire—built on strong principles of quality, clarity, and long-term value.

Connected

Explore how thoughts are interconnected with the interactive graph and follow the backlinks to uncover unexpected relationships.

Compounded

With every note, idea, and insight, my Second Brain grows—compounding in value, just like a money investment.

content_html_zh:
精心制作、策划、连接、复合

欢迎来到我的公共第二大脑，这是一个精心设计的知识库，我的笔记、想法和见解随着时间的推移经过精心策划、联系和复合。 该金库被建模为数字 Zettelkasten 和花园。

导航

🔍

搜索

使用右上角的搜索栏或按 cmd+k（Windows 上为 ctrl+k）查找任何术语，或打开完整搜索页面。

🔗

关注链接

单击注释并按照链接和反向链接进行更深入的研究，或使用 Graph Explorer 进行语义搜索和隐藏连接。

🧠

图表视图

与页面底部的图表进行交互，以可视化笔记之间的联系并直接导航。

内容地图

我的第二大脑在不断成长，虽然我在下面列出了一些基本的内容地图 (MOC) 起点，但在您探索时还有更多主题需要发现。 请随意深入研究以下任何领域：

深度生活

数字极简主义，深度工作，什么使生活幸福，对日记的思考，斯多葛派，例行公事，为幸福生活而读书，极简主义，无路可走，哑巴电话，我在国外学到的东西

尼奥的

Vim、Neovim 设置、Vim 动作、Vim 中的查询数据库、Vim 语言、Vim for Obsidian、为什么 Vim 不仅仅是一个编辑器、Vim Anywhere、Unix 哲学、Dotfiles、TUI

享受探索我的第二大脑的乐趣。 我希望您能找到宝贵的见解和联系，在您的旅程中激发或帮助您。

关于第二大脑

有关这些笔记的质量和预期内容，请查看免责声明。 否则，请详细了解此知识库背后的原则以及它的组织方式以提供持久的价值。

精雕细琢

精心设计的笔记具有教育意义和启发性——建立在质量、清晰度和长期价值的强有力原则之上。

已连接

探索思想如何与交互式图表相互关联，并按照反向链接发现意想不到的关系。

复合型

随着每一个笔记、想法和洞察力的增长，我的第二大脑的价值不断增加，就像金钱投资一样。
